// Skeleton of the handler of api.kvp, generated by kvpack: the object an
// application gives to the multiplexer, with a method per command.
// Copy it under a name of your own and fill it; this file is written
// again every time the code is generated.
//
//    oSrv := ApiServer():New( MyHandler():New() )
//    oSrv:Dispatch( hMsg, oCtx, @nErr )

#include "hbclass.ch"
#include "common.ch"
#include "kvpack.ch"
#include "api_kvp.ch"

CREATE CLASS MyHandler

   METHOD OnLogin( oMsg, oCtx )
   METHOD OnPing( oMsg, oCtx )
   METHOD OnQuery( oMsg, oCtx )
   METHOD OnEvery( oMsg, oCtx )

ENDCLASS

// Command login (1).
//    oMsg:request   ApiLogin: user, password, when, tags
//    oMsg:reply     ApiLoginReply, new and empty, to fill: name, expires, level, events, owner
//    oMsg:Pack()    the reply as a message
//    oCtx           what the caller of Dispatch gave for this call
METHOD OnLogin( oMsg, oCtx ) CLASS MyHandler

   HB_SYMBOL_UNUSED( oMsg )
   HB_SYMBOL_UNUSED( oCtx )

   RETURN NIL

// Command ping (2).
//    oMsg:request   ApiHeartbeat: no fields
//    oMsg:reply     NIL: the command declares no reply
//    oMsg:Pack()    the reply as a message
//    oCtx           what the caller of Dispatch gave for this call
METHOD OnPing( oMsg, oCtx ) CLASS MyHandler

   HB_SYMBOL_UNUSED( oMsg )
   HB_SYMBOL_UNUSED( oCtx )

   RETURN NIL

// Command query (3).
//    oMsg:request   ApiQuery: sql
//    oMsg:reply     ApiQueryReply, new and empty, to fill: code, note, limit, author, rows, extra
//    oMsg:Pack()    the reply as a message
//    oCtx           what the caller of Dispatch gave for this call
METHOD OnQuery( oMsg, oCtx ) CLASS MyHandler

   HB_SYMBOL_UNUSED( oMsg )
   HB_SYMBOL_UNUSED( oCtx )

   RETURN NIL

// Command every (4).
//    oMsg:request   ApiEvery: r_int32, r_int64, r_ts, r_text, r_bin, r_bool, r_float64, r_ds, r_msg, r_rec, o_int32, o_int64, o_ts, o_text, o_bin, o_bool, o_float64, o_ds, o_msg, o_rec, n_int32, n_int64, n_ts, n_text, n_bin, n_bool, n_float64, n_ds, n_msg, n_rec, on_int32, on_int64, on_ts, on_text, on_bin, on_bool, on_float64, on_ds, on_msg, on_rec, l_int32, l_int64, l_ts, l_text, l_bin, l_bool, l_float64, l_ds, l_msg, l_rec, r_set, o_set
//    oMsg:reply     NIL: the command declares no reply
//    oMsg:Pack()    the reply as a message
//    oCtx           what the caller of Dispatch gave for this call
METHOD OnEvery( oMsg, oCtx ) CLASS MyHandler

   HB_SYMBOL_UNUSED( oMsg )
   HB_SYMBOL_UNUSED( oCtx )

   RETURN NIL
